test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18th November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Six friends, Ravi, Kavya, Mahima, Gita, Mohan and Neha, are sitting in a straight line, all facing the north. Kavya is not sitting at either of the ends. Neha is sitting between Ravi and Mohan. Mohan is sitting to the immediate right of Gita. There are three friends sitting between Ravi and Kavya. Kavya is sitting to the immediate right of Mahima. Who is sitting at the fifth position from the left end?
solution:
Total six friends facing north:- Ravi, Kavya, Mahima, Gita, Mohan and Neha

1) Neha is sitting between Ravi and Mohan.

2) Mohan is sitting to the immediate right of Gita.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3afcc7eb150b74fcd71ef776d36ee6b30903af096c4cc8fd6f412ddc565ec6d.png] 

3) There are three friends sitting between Ravi and Kavya.

4) Kavya is not sitting at either of the ends.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/478a34f16fbfbd62771da86d153f64d9e3c4f45218f1b36f5c5d11860da3c099.png] 

5) Kavya is sitting to the immediate right of Mahima.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e261cf99a3198feb8c599de21fc7fb319604e8c9d4492eeb06d1e2a25454b16a.png] 

Hence, 'Neha' is sitting at the fifth position from the left end.
